title: Senior System Analyst Corporate Solutions (Finance Solutions)
job_description:
JOB REQUIREMENTS Malaysian citizen. Pass Bahasa Malaysia Language including an oral test at the Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) level. Possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent qualification in a relevant field recognized by the Government. Minimum 7 to 10 years of relevant experience, particularly in developing and supporting financial applications, particularly in SAP ECC6, SAP BW, SAP DM, and SAP BPC, and other future financial applications. Possess a certification from Oracle or SAP in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is an advantage. Technical Skills Holding SAP certification, experience in S/4HANA implementation, and familiarity with FI and RE-FX modules is advantageous. Proficient in multiple ERP/financial modules and their functionalities. Possess working knowledge of project management methodologies and business analysis techniques. Skilled in designing and developing process flows, user journeys, and wireframes. Experienced in integrating applications with enterprise backend systems, databases (MS SQL Server and Oracle), Business Process Management (BPM), or through APIs (REST). Well-versed in Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC), Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes. Possess a strong knowledge of ERP/Financial modules and functionalities i.e. AP, GL, AR, Fixed Asset, Procurement, Financial Reporting etc. Familiar with ERP/Financial processes, routing and approval flow i.e. payment process, procurement process etc. Knowledgeable in ERP/Financial integration approaches and methodologies with external system. Soft Skills Display strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Must be detail-oriented team players who can interact, communicate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to reach a shared goal. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia (BM), with proficiency in English as an added advantage. Excellent interpersonal abilities and the ability to perform under pressure to meet tight deadlines. Ability to see a task through from assignment to completion with minimal supervision. Proactively available for tasks beyond regular hours when needed.

JOB DESCRIPTION Participate in projects and support existing financial applications, including SAP ECC6, SAP BW, SAP DM, SAP BPC, and non-SAP financial applications under the Corporate Solutions section of the Digital Enterprise Solutions department. Determine financial application requirements for users through the following activities: Analyze current and future needs, and current practices of business users and stakeholders to identify solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs, objectives, and challenges. Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and workflows. Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications for technical teams. Provide impact analysis and advisory services. Create detailed documentation, including business requirements, process flows, Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), use cases, and user stories. Plan, schedule, and document new developments and enhancements to existing financial applications. Organize and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions with users. Develop Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) objects and identify opportunities for development improvements, implementing action plans, especially for ABAP-based solutions. Provide first-level application support to ensure system availability. Troubleshoot ABAP and non-ABAP applications, databases, and system issues reported by users to determine root causes and resolutions. Collaborate with business owners, digital technology teams (Infrastructure, Network, Security, Application), and vendors for project delivery and Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations. Examine and implement best practices in application development and system maintenance to improve processes. Implement processes, development standards, and system improvements to enhance system stability and performance. Work with the Strategy Planning and Enterprise Architecture team to define and implement new application architecture. Conduct periodic project assessments and reviews to ensure compliance with architectural standards.

Casual attire Hot desk environment Nearby LRT (KLCC), MRT (Conlay & Bukit Bintang) & Monorail (Raja Chulan) Statutory deductions Commission incentives Annual leave Dental allowance Optical allowance Panel clinic Life insurance Attendance bonus Learning incentive Medical Benefits EPF SOCSO

ERP & Core Finance Module Configuration: Financial Data Mapping & Custom Workflows
